description:
I-Findo iyi-tracker yendawo ye-GPS, i-locator yomndeni, kanye ne-tracker yomndeni eyenzelwe ukukusiza ukuthi uhlale uxhumene nabantu ababaluleke kakhulu. Kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ufuna ukuthola abangani, ukuhambisana namalungu omndeni, noma uqiniseke ukuthi bafika ngokuphephile, i-Findo ikunikeza ukwabelana ngendawo ngesikhathi sangempela kuhlelo lokusebenza olulodwa olulula. Ithenjwe ngabasebenzisi abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingu-12 emhlabeni jikelele, i-Findo isiza imindeni, abangani, kanye nabantu abaseduze ukuthi babelane ngezindawo ze-GPS ezibukhoma, bathole izaziso zendawo ehlakaniphile, bahlole amazinga ebhethri, futhi bathumele izaziso eziphuthumayo.

Nge-Findo, ungakwazi:
• Thola abangani ngokushesha: Buka indawo yangempela yabangani bakho kumephu eyimfihlo, evikelekile.

• Sebenzisa izici ze-tracker yomndeni: Setha izaziso ezihlakaniphile ukuze waziswe lapho othile efika, ehamba, noma edinga usizo.
• Thembela ku-locator yomndeni evikelekile: Hlukanisa umndeni, abangani, kanye nosebenza nabo ngokulawula okugcwele ukuthi ubani obona idatha yakho yendawo ebukhoma.
• Qala ngaphandle kokubhalisa: Akukho ukubhaliswa okudingekayo—kufanelekile ezimweni eziphuthumayo, emihlanganweni esheshayo, noma ekulandeleleni kwansuku zonke.

• Landelela izindawo ngaphandle kokuqeda ibhethri lakho: Ubuchwepheshe bethu obuthuthukisiwe busiza ekuhlinzekeni ngezibuyekezo zendawo ezinembile ngenkathi kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwebhethri.

Nakhu ozokuthola:

UKWABELANA NGENDAWO YE-GPS NGESIKHATHI SANGEQINISO
Hlala wazi ukuthi umndeni wakho uphephile. Lesi sitholi somndeni esiku-1 sikuvumela ukuthi uhlole izindawo ze-GPS ezibukhoma kumephu, wabelane ngendawo yakho nombuthano wakho, uthole abangani, futhi uhlale uxhumekile usuku lonke.

ISITHOMBE SOMNDENI ESIPHEZULU
Yiba nokuthula kwengqondo okukhulu. Lesi sitholi somndeni sisebenza njengenethi yokuphepha ephephile, okwenza kube lula ukuhlola ukuthi izingane zifikile yini ekuzijwayezeni noma umlingani wakho ufikile ekhaya ngokuphephile. Phequlula idatha yokuhamba ye-GPS yomlando ukuze ubone ukuthi abathandekayo bakho bebekuphi usuku lonke.

XOXA FUTHI UTHOLE ABANGANI BAKHO
Hlanganisa imihlangano kalula. Lesi sitholi somuntu esiku-GPS sikuvumela ukuthi ubone izikhathi zokufika, ubuke umzila womngane wakho, futhi uhlangane ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi.

IZIXWAYISO ZENDALO EHLAKANIPHILE
Setha izindawo ezikhethiwe njengesikole, ikhaya, noma umsebenzi. I-Findo, uhlelo lokusebenza lokuthola indawo yomndeni, izokwazisa ngesikhathi ilungu lombuthano wakho lifika noma lishiya lezo zindawo ezithile.

USIZO LWESIMO ESIPHUTHUMAYO
Udinga usizo? Thepha kanye ukuze uthumele isaziso esiphuthumayo kuwo wonke amalungu ombuthano wakho wangasese.

IMEPHU YE-GPS ESEMQOKA
Yenza imephu yakho izwakale njengeyakho. Khetha izithonjana ezenziwe ngokwezifiso zomuntu ngamunye, faka amathegi ezindaweni ozithandayo njengeKhaya, Umsebenzi, Ijimu, noma isitolo sakho sekhofi, bese wakha imephu ye-GPS ekhombisa impilo yakho.

Qala ngokushesha bese udala umbuthano wakho wokuqala ngemizuzwana. Landa i-Findo, ukulandelela indawo ye-GPS kanye nokulandelela umndeni okukusiza ukuthi uthole abangani, ugcine abathandekayo bakho beseduze, futhi uhlale unolwazi.

NGAPHAMBI KOKUQALA
I-Findo isebenza ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti—akudingeki ukubhalisa. Yazi nje ukuthi ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti, idatha yakho igcinwa kuphela kudivayisi yakho yamanje futhi ayikwazi ukutholwa uma ushintsha amafoni noma ususa uhlelo lokusebenza.

Kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela ukuthi ukusetshenziswa okuqhubekayo kwezinsizakalo zokulandelela indawo ye-GPS ezisebenza ngemuva kunganciphisa impilo yebhethri.
